title: What Scripture Actually Means by Guard Your Heart
caption:
"Guard your heart" gets quoted like it's about protecting your feelings. Proverbs 4:23 was never talking about your feelings. It was talking about your attention, your appetite, what you let your eyes linger on.

Your phone was never neutral ground in that fight. The app doesn't guard anything for you. That job stayed yours.

Save this before the next scroll.

#faith #scripture #fightthephone #godlyman #christianmen
